causal_question: Can exact online selection of the smallest registered high-byte table width keep the working FP16 ambient momentum below 14 bits per coordinate throughout the warmup transition without losing the already-passing MFU or transition identity?

theory.invariant: Every low byte is literal; every high byte is either a fixed-width table index or an exact escaped literal. Therefore choosing the table width changes storage only, never the decoded FP16 word.
theory.candidate_cost: For n words, r regions, dictionary size K, and E_K exceptions, variable bytes are ceil(n*log2(K)/8) + r*(K-1) + E_K. Low bytes and offsets are common and cancel in the selection.
theory.why_adaptation_is_required: The fixed 4-bit c_fc and 5-bit c_proj widths were selected on the terminal checkpoint. The integrated gate shows a 6.535 MB increase in block-coded exceptions by update 8, so endpoint entropy is not a uniform-in-time model of optimizer history.
theory.why_this_is_not_a_model_guess: The decoded momentum field, Pair-VQ weights, feedback codec, attention mapping, optimizer, data order, schedule, and loss are unchanged. Only a lossless container parameter is selected from a preregistered finite set.

frozen_candidate.selection: independently minimize exact persistent bytes for each scope after its block histograms are known; ties choose the smaller dictionary
frozen_candidate.special_values: all binary16 words including signed zero, subnormal, infinity, and NaN payloads remain bit exact

exact_config_gate.capacity_observation: record total and per-scope packed bytes after every update

decision_rule.pass: All identity tests pass, every one of nine updates is at or below 99,090,432 bytes, median MFU is at least 20%, and no hidden raw state exists.
decision_rule.failure: Reject the high-byte-table family as the persistent FP16 owner if adaptive widths still exceed the ceiling or break exact transition/resume identity.
decision_rule.after_pass: Because decoding is bit exact, do not rerun the 238-update loss endpoint. Seal the retained 5.368512 CE and 0.007512 gap with the measured adaptive state and systems numbers; then run a second seed of the already-working full-MLP structure rather than scale model size.
